source_operation.summary: Search project code using natural language
source_operation.description:
Introduced in GitLab 18.11.

Searches indexed project code using semantic (meaning-based) similarity rather than
keyword matching. Use this when you do not know the exact symbol or file name, or
to discover how a behavior is implemented across the codebase.

Primary use cases:
- When you do not know the exact symbol or file path
- To see how a behavior or feature is implemented across the codebase
- To discover related implementations (clients, jobs, workers)

How to use:
- Provide a concise, specific query with concrete keywords
- Use directory_path to narrow scope (e.g. "app/services/")
- Prefer precise intent over broad terms

Results are grouped by file. Each file includes merged line ranges with content
and a relevance score (0.0-1.0). The response includes an overall confidence
level (high/medium/low/unknown) based on score distribution. Results are
filtered by Duo context exclusion settings.

Requires semantic code search to be enabled and indexed for the project namespace.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Natural language search query (e.g. "authentication middleware", "rate limiting logic")

parameters.name: directory_path
parameters.description: Restrict search to files under this directory path (e.g. "app/services/"). Must be a relative path — no leading slash, no .. segments.

parameters.name: knn
parameters.description: Number of nearest neighbours to retrieve internally (default: 64). Higher values improve recall at the cost of latency.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20).

404.description: Not found - project not found or semantic code search unavailable

422.description: Unprocessable entity - project has no embeddings

source_operation.description:
This feature was introduced in GitLab 12.7.

**DEPRECATED**: This endpoint is deprecated and for GitLab.com use only.

This will only ever decrease the number of indexed namespaces. Providing a value higher than the current rolled out percentage will have no effect.

This percentage is never persisted but is used to calculate the number of namespaces to rollback.

source_operation.summary: Rollout namespaces to be indexed up to n%
source_operation.description:
This feature was introduced in GitLab 12.7.

**DEPRECATED**: This endpoint is deprecated and for GitLab.com use only.

This will only ever increase the number of indexed namespaces. Providing a value lower than the current rolled out percentage will have no effect.

This percentage is never persisted but is used to calculate the number of new namespaces to rollout.

If the same percentage is applied again at a later time, due to possible new namespaces being created during the period, some of them will also be indexed. Therefore you may expect that setting this to 10%, then waiting a month and setting to 10% again will trigger new namespaces to be added (i.e. 10% of the number of newly created namespaces in the last month within the given plan).

admin_compliance_framework.description: Create, read, update, and delete compliance frameworks. Users with this permission can also assign a compliance framework label to a project, and set the default framework of a group.

admin_cicd_variables.description: Create, read, update, and delete CI/CD variables.

manage_deploy_tokens.description: Manage deploy tokens at the group or project level.

manage_group_access_tokens.description: Create, read, update, and delete group access tokens. When creating a token, users with this custom permission must select a role for that token that has the same or fewer permissions as the default role used as the base for the custom role.

admin_group_member.description: Add or remove users in a group, and assign roles to users. When assigning a role, users with this custom permission must select a role that has the same or fewer permissions as the default role used as the base for their custom role.

admin_integrations.description: Create, read, update, and delete integrations with external applications.

manage_merge_request_settings.description: Configure merge request settings at the group or project level. Group actions include managing merge checks and approval settings. Project actions include managing MR configurations, approval rules and settings, and branch targets. In order to enable Suggested reviewers, the "Manage project access tokens" custom permission needs to be enabled.

manage_project_access_tokens.description: Create, read, update, and delete project access tokens. When creating a token, users with this custom permission must select a role for that token that has the same or fewer permissions as the default role used as the base for the custom role.

admin_protected_branch.description: Create, read, update, and delete protected branches for a project.

admin_protected_environments.description: Create, read, update, and delete protected environments

admin_push_rules.description: Configure push rules for repositories at the group or project level.

admin_runners.description: Create, view, edit, and delete group or project Runners. Includes configuring Runner settings.

admin_security_attributes.description: Manage the security categories and attributes belonging to a top-level group. Also requires the `read_security_attribute` permission.

admin_terraform_state.description: Execute terraform commands, lock/unlock terraform state files, and remove file versions.

admin_vulnerability.description: Edit the status, linked issue, and severity of a vulnerability object. Also requires the `read_vulnerability` permission.

read_agent_artifacts.description: Read GitLab Duo Agent Platform artifacts, including audit events and session metadata, that are exposed through the agent artifacts dashboard.

read_compliance_dashboard.description: Read compliance capabilities including adherence, violations, and frameworks for groups and projects.

read_virtual_registry.description: Allows read access to virtual registries at the group level. Enables users to resolve packages through the virtual registry without requiring broader group membership permissions. Only works on top level groups.

update_sec_ai_workflow_settings.description: Update security AI workflow settings such as SAST Vulnerability Resolution. Also requires the `read_vulnerability` permission.

read_admin_cicd.description: Read CI/CD details for runners and jobs in the Admin Area.

read_dependency.description: Allows read-only access to the dependencies and licenses.

read_admin_groups.description: Read group details in the Admin Area.

read_admin_projects.description: Read project details in the Admin Area.

read_code.description: Allows read-only access to the source code in the user interface. Does not allow users to edit or download repository archives, clone or pull repositories, view source code in an IDE, or view merge requests for private projects. You can download individual files because read-only access inherently grants the ability to make a local copy of the file.

read_runners.description: Allows read-only access to group or project runners, including the runner fleet dashboard.

read_security_attribute.description: Allows read-only access to the security categories and attributes that belong to a top-level group.

read_admin_subscription.description: Read subscription details in the Admin area.

read_admin_monitoring.description: Read system information such as background migrations, health checks, and Gitaly in the Admin Area.

read_admin_users.description: Read the user list and user details in the Admin area.

read_vulnerability.description: Read vulnerability reports and security dashboards.

abuse_notification_email.description: Abuse reports will be sent to this address if it is set. Abuse reports are always available in the admin area.

authn_data_retention_cleanup_enabled.description: Enable authentication data retention cleanup workers to enforce retention policies

oauth_access_token_expires_in.description: Lifetime of OAuth access tokens in seconds.

decompress_archive_file_timeout.description: Default timeout for decompressing archived files, in seconds. Set to 0 to disable timeouts.

default_artifacts_expire_in.description: Set the default expiration time for each job's artifacts

default_ci_config_path.description: The instance default CI/CD configuration file and path for new projects

default_project_creation.description: Determine if developers can create projects in the group

default_branch_protection.description: Determine if developers can push to default branch

default_branch_protection_defaults.description: Determine if developers can push to default branch

allowed_to_push.description: An array of access levels allowed to push

access_level.description: A valid access level

allow_force_push.description: Allow force push for all users with push access.

allowed_to_merge.description: An array of access levels allowed to merge

access_level.description: A valid access level

default_projects_limit.description: The maximum number of personal projects

security_update_scheduler_max_concurrenc.description: Maximum number of dependency management security update scheduler jobs that run concurrently across the Sidekiq fleet

disable_admin_oauth_scopes.description: Stop administrators from connecting to non-trusted OAuth applications.

disable_feed_token.description: Disable display of RSS/Atom and Calendar `feed_tokens`

domain_denylist_enabled.description: Enable domain denylist for sign ups

domain_denylist.description: Users with e-mail addresses that match these domain(s) will NOT be able to sign-up. Wildcards allowed. Enter multiple entries on separate lines. Ex: domain.com, *.domain.com

domain_allowlist.description: ONLY users with e-mail addresses that match these domain(s) will be able to sign-up. Wildcards allowed. Enter multiple entries on separate lines. Ex: domain.com, *.domain.com

outbound_local_requests_whitelist.description: List of trusted domains or IP addresses to which local requests are allowed when local requests for webhooks and integrations are disabled.

email_otp_enabled.description: Enable Email-based one-time passwords (OTP) as a multi-factor authentication method.

iframe_rendering_enabled.description: Allow rendering of iframes in Markdown.

iframe_rendering_allowlist.description: Allowed iframe src host[:port] entries. Enter multiple entries separated by commas or on separate lines.

iframe_rendering_allowlist_raw.description: Raw newline- or comma-separated list of allowed iframe src host[:port] entries.

eks_account_id.description: Amazon account ID for EKS integration

eks_access_key_id.description: Access key ID for the EKS integration IAM user

eks_secret_access_key.description: Secret access key for the EKS integration IAM user

email_author_in_body.description: Some email servers do not support overriding the email sender name. Enable this option to include the name of the author of the issue, merge request or comment in the email body instead.

email_confirmation_setting.description: Email confirmation setting, possible values: `off`, `soft`, and `hard`

enabled_git_access_protocol.description: Allow only the selected protocols to be used for Git access.

gitaly_timeout_default.description: Default Gitaly timeout, in seconds. Set to 0 to disable timeouts.

gitaly_timeout_fast.description: Gitaly fast operation timeout, in seconds. Set to 0 to disable timeouts.

gitaly_timeout_medium.description: Medium Gitaly timeout, in seconds. Set to 0 to disable timeouts.

gravatar_enabled.description: Flag indicating if the Gravatar service is enabled

help_page_support_url.description: Alternate support URL for help page and help dropdown

help_page_text.description: Custom text displayed on the help page

home_page_url.description: We will redirect non-logged in users to this page

housekeeping_enabled.description: Enable automatic repository housekeeping (git repack, git gc)

housekeeping_full_repack_period.description: Number of Git pushes after which a full 'git repack' is run.

housekeeping_gc_period.description: Number of Git pushes after which 'git gc' is run.

housekeeping_incremental_repack_period.description: Number of Git pushes after which an incremental 'git repack' is run.

housekeeping_optimize_repository_period.description: Number of Git pushes after which Gitaly is asked to optimize a repository.

html_emails_enabled.description: By default GitLab sends emails in HTML and plain text formats so mail clients can choose what format to use. Disable this option if you only want to send emails in plain text format.

import_sources.description: Enabled sources for code import during project creation. OmniAuth must be configured for GitHub, Bitbucket, and GitLab.com

invisible_captcha_enabled.description: Enable Invisible Captcha spam detection during signup.

max_artifacts_size.description: Set the maximum file size for each job's artifacts

max_github_response_size_limit.description: Maximum allowed size in MB for GitHub API responses. 0 for unlimited.

max_github_response_json_value_count.description: Maximum allowed object count for GitHub API responses. 0 for unlimited. Count is an estimate based on the number of : , { and [ occurrences in the response.

max_import_remote_file_size.description: Maximum remote file size in MB for imports from external object storages

max_pages_size.description: Maximum size of pages in MB

max_pages_custom_domains_per_project.description: Maximum number of GitLab Pages custom domains per project

max_terraform_state_size_bytes.description: Maximum size in bytes of the Terraform state file. Set this to 0 for unlimited file size.

metrics_method_call_threshold.description: A method call is only tracked when it takes longer to complete than the given amount of milliseconds.

password_authentication_enabled.description: Flag indicating if password authentication is enabled for the web interface

password_authentication_enabled_for_web.description: Flag indicating if password authentication is enabled for the web interface

signin_enabled.description: Flag indicating if password authentication is enabled for the web interface

password_authentication_enabled_for_git.description: Flag indicating if password authentication is enabled for Git over HTTP(S)

performance_bar_allowed_group_id.description: Deprecated: Use :performance_bar_allowed_group_path instead. Path of the group that is allowed to toggle the performance bar.

performance_bar_allowed_group_path.description: Path of the group that is allowed to toggle the performance bar.

performance_bar_enabled.description: Deprecated: Pass `performance_bar_allowed_group_path: nil` instead. Allow enabling the performance.

personal_access_token_prefix.description: Prefix to prepend to all personal access tokens

require_personal_access_token_expiry.description: Flag indicating if Personal / Group / Project access token expiry is required

polling_interval_multiplier.description: Interval multiplier used by endpoints that perform polling. Set to 0 to disable polling.

push_event_hooks_limit.description: Maximum number of changes (branches or tags) in a single push above which webhooks and integrations are not triggered. Setting to `0` does not disable throttling.

push_event_activities_limit.description: Maximum number of changes (branches or tags) in a single push above which a bulk push event is created. Setting to `0` does not disable throttling.

recaptcha_enabled.description: Helps prevent bots from creating accounts

repository_checks_enabled.description: GitLab will periodically run 'git fsck' in all project and wiki repositories to look for silent disk corruption issues.

repository_storages_weighted.description: Storage paths for new projects with a weighted value ranging from 0 to 100

require_two_factor_authentication.description: Require all users to set up Two-factor authentication

two_factor_grace_period.description: Amount of time (in hours) that users are allowed to skip forced configuration of two-factor authentication

restricted_visibility_levels.description: Selected levels cannot be used by non-admin users for groups, projects or snippets. If the public level is restricted, user profiles are only visible to logged in users.

session_expire_delay.description: Session duration in minutes. GitLab restart is required to apply changes.

session_expire_from_init.description: Expires sessions based off the creation date rather than last activity

shared_runners_enabled.description: Enable shared runners for new projects

valid_runner_registrars.description: List of types which are allowed to register a GitLab runner

signup_enabled.description: Flag indicating if sign up is enabled

sourcegraph_public_only.description: Only allow public projects to communicate with Sourcegraph

spam_check_endpoint_enabled.description: Enable Spam Check via external API endpoint

spam_check_endpoint_url.description: The URL of the external Spam Check service endpoint

terminal_max_session_time.description: Maximum time for web terminal websocket connection (in seconds). Set to 0 for unlimited time.

usage_ping_enabled.description: Every week GitLab will report license usage back to GitLab, Inc.

local_markdown_version.description: Local markdown version, increase this value when any cached markdown should be invalidated

allow_local_requests_from_hooks_and_serv.description: Deprecated: Use :allow_local_requests_from_web_hooks_and_services instead. Allow requests to the local network from hooks and services.

mailgun_signing_key.description: The Mailgun HTTP webhook signing key for receiving events from webhook

snowplow_app_id.description: The Snowplow site name / application id

issues_create_limit.description: Maximum number of issue creation requests allowed per minute per user. Set to 0 for unlimited requests per minute.

raw_blob_request_limit.description: Maximum number of requests per minute for each raw path. Set to 0 for unlimited requests per minute.

raw_blob_request_limit_unauthenticated.description: Maximum number of requests per minute for a raw blob for unauthenticated requests. Set to 0 for unlimited requests per minute.

wiki_page_max_content_bytes.description: Maximum wiki page content size in bytes

description_and_note_max_size.description: Maximum work item, merge request, and vulnerability description and comment content size in bytes.

wiki_asciidoc_allow_uri_includes.description: Allow URI includes for AsciiDoc wiki pages

require_admin_approval_after_user_signup.description: Require explicit admin approval for new signups

whats_new_variant.description: What's new variant, possible values: `all_tiers`, `current_tier`, and `disabled`.

user_deactivation_emails_enabled.description: Send emails to users upon account deactivation

enable_artifact_external_redirect_warnin.description: Show the external redirect page that warns you about user-generated content in GitLab Pages

users_get_by_id_limit.description: Maximum number of calls to the /users/:id API per 10 minutes per user. Set to 0 for unlimited requests.

runner_token_expiration_interval.description: Token expiration interval for shared runners, in seconds

group_runner_token_expiration_interval.description: Token expiration interval for group runners, in seconds

project_runner_token_expiration_interval.description: Token expiration interval for project runners, in seconds

pipeline_limit_per_project_user_sha.description: Maximum number of pipeline creation requests allowed per minute per user and commit. Set to 0 for unlimited requests per minute.

pipeline_limit_per_user.description: Maximum number of pipeline creation requests allowed per minute per user. Set to 0 for unlimited requests per minute.

ci_lint_limit_per_user.description: Maximum number of CI Lint requests allowed per minute per user. Set to 0 for unlimited requests per minute.

jira_connect_application_key.description: ID of the OAuth application used to authenticate with the GitLab for Jira Cloud app.

jira_connect_public_key_storage_enabled.description: Enable public key storage for the GitLab for Jira Cloud app.

jira_connect_proxy_url.description: URL of the GitLab instance used as a proxy for the GitLab for Jira Cloud app.

jira_forge_app_id.description: Atlassian Forge app ID (ARI) of the GitLab for Jira Cloud app, used to verify inbound Forge Invocation Tokens.

bulk_import_concurrent_pipeline_batch_li.description: Maximum simultaneous direct transfer batch exports to process.

concurrent_relation_batch_export_limit.description: Maximum number of simultaneous batch export jobs to process.

bulk_import_enabled.description: Enable migrating GitLab groups and projects by direct transfer

bulk_import_max_download_file.description: Maximum download file size in MB when importing from source GitLab instances by direct transfer

autocomplete_users_limit.description: Rate limit for authenticated requests to users autocomplete endpoint

autocomplete_users_unauthenticated_limit.description: Rate limit for authenticated requests to users autocomplete endpoint

concurrent_github_import_jobs_limit.description: Github Importer maximum number of simultaneous import jobs

concurrent_bitbucket_import_jobs_limit.description: Bitbucket Cloud Importer maximum number of simultaneous import jobs

concurrent_bitbucket_server_import_jobs_.description: Bitbucket Server Importer maximum number of simultaneous import jobs

allow_runner_registration_token.description: Allow registering runners using a registration token

ci_max_includes.description: Maximum number of includes per pipeline

ci_max_caches_per_job.description: Maximum number of caches that can be defined in a single CI/CD job

ci_job_live_trace_enabled.description: Turn on incremental logging for job logs.

git_push_pipeline_limit.description: Set the limit for pipelines and branches that can be triggered when creating a Git push. Set to 0 to disable the limit

security_policy_global_group_approvers_e.description: Query scan result policy approval groups globally

slack_app_enabled.description: Enable the GitLab for Slack app

slack_app_id.description: The client ID of the GitLab for Slack app

slack_app_secret.description: The client secret of the GitLab for Slack app. Used for authenticating OAuth requests from the app

slack_app_signing_secret.description: The signing secret of the GitLab for Slack app. Used for authenticating API requests from the app

slack_app_verification_token.description: The verification token of the GitLab for Slack app. This method of authentication is deprecated by Slack and used only for authenticating slash commands from the app

namespace_aggregation_schedule_lease_dur.description: Maximum duration (in seconds) between refreshes of namespace statistics (Default: 300)

project_jobs_api_rate_limit.description: Maximum authenticated requests to /project/:id/jobs per minute

security_txt_content.description: Public security contact information made available at https://gitlab.example.com/.well-known/security.txt

downstream_pipeline_trigger_limit_per_pr.description: Maximum number of downstream pipelines that can be triggered per minute (for a given project, user, and commit).

ai_action_api_rate_limit.description: Maximum requests a user can make per 8 hours to aiAction endpoint

code_suggestions_api_rate_limit.description: Maximum requests a user can make per minute to code suggestions endpoint

resource_usage_limits.description: Definition for resource usage limits enforced in Sidekiq workers

vscode_extension_marketplace.description: Settings for VS Code Extension Marketplace

enabled.description: Enables VS Code Extension Marketplace for Web IDE and Workspaces

preset.description: The preset configuration of URL's for the VS Code Extension Marketplace

custom_values.description: VS Code Extension Marketplace URL's when preset is 'custom'

minimum_language_server_version.description: The minimum language server version to accept requests from

terraform_state_encryption_enabled.description: Enable encryption for Terraform state files

logging_field_schema_version.description: Logging field schema version (v0, v1, …). Cannot be downgraded.

logging_field_dual_emit_target.description: Version to dual-emit alongside schema_version. Must be strictly greater than schema_version, or omit/null to disable.

rsa_key_restriction.description: Restrictions on the complexity of uploaded RSA keys. A value of -1 disables all RSA keys.

dsa_key_restriction.description: Restrictions on the complexity of uploaded DSA keys. A value of -1 disables all DSA keys.

ecdsa_key_restriction.description: Restrictions on the complexity of uploaded ECDSA keys. A value of -1 disables all ECDSA keys.

ed25519_key_restriction.description: Restrictions on the complexity of uploaded ED25519 keys. A value of -1 disables all ED25519 keys.

ecdsa_sk_key_restriction.description: Restrictions on the complexity of uploaded ECDSA_SK keys. A value of -1 disables all ECDSA_SK keys.

ed25519_sk_key_restriction.description: Restrictions on the complexity of uploaded ED25519_SK keys. A value of -1 disables all ED25519_SK keys.

allow_account_deletion.description: Set to `true` to allow users to delete their accounts. Premium and Ultimate only.

allow_application_default_credentials_fo.description: Allow Google Cloud Application Default Credentials for offline transfer. Even when enabled, only administrators can use these credentials, and the bucket name must start with `gitlab-offline-transfer-`. Has no effect on GitLab.com. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/602489) in GitLab 19.3.

allow_bypass_placeholder_confirmation.description: Skip confirmation when administrators reassign placeholder users. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/534330) in GitLab 18.0.

allow_local_requests_from_system_hooks.description: Allow requests to the local network from system hooks.

allow_local_requests_from_web_hooks_and_.description: Allow requests to the local network from webhooks and integrations.

allow_project_creation_for_guest_and_bel.description: Indicates whether users assigned up to the Guest role can create groups and personal projects. Defaults to `true`.

allow_s3_compatible_storage_for_offline_.description: Allow S3-compatible object storage for offline transfer. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/579705) in GitLab 18.9.

archive_builds_in_human_readable.description: Set the duration for which the jobs are considered as old and expired. After that time passes, the jobs are archived and no longer able to be retried. Make it empty to never expire jobs. It has to be no less than 1 day, for example: `15 days`, `1 month`, `2 years`.

asciidoc_max_includes.description: Maximum limit of AsciiDoc include directives being processed in any one document. Default: 32. Maximum: 64.

authorized_keys_enabled.description: By default, the `authorized_keys` file supports Git over SSH without additional configuration. GitLab can be optimized to authenticate SSH keys via the database file. Only disable this if you have configured your OpenSSH server to use the AuthorizedKeysCommand.

auto_accept_awarded_achievements.description: If `true`, newly awarded achievements are accepted automatically and appear on user profiles immediately. Does not affect achievements awarded before this setting is enabled. Recipients can still hide any achievement. Default value: `false`. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/607750) in GitLab 19.4.

auto_devops_domain.description: Specify a domain to use by default for every project's Auto Review Apps and Auto Deploy stages.

auto_devops_enabled.description: Enable Auto DevOps for projects by default. It automatically builds, tests, and deploys applications based on a predefined CI/CD configuration.

bulk_import_max_download_file_size.description: Maximum download file size when importing from source GitLab instances by direct transfer.

can_create_group.description: Indicates whether users can create top-level groups. Defaults to `true`.

ci_delete_pipelines_in_seconds_limit_hum.description: Maximum value that is allowed for configuring pipeline retention. Defaults to `1 year`.

ci_max_total_yaml_size_bytes.description: The maximum amount of memory, in bytes, that can be allocated for the pipeline configuration, with all included YAML configuration files.

ci_partitions_in_seconds_limit.description: The time window, in seconds, before new CI partitions are created and the system switches to the next set of partitions. Must be between 1 month and 6 months. Default is 1 month (`2592000`). Write-only. Not returned in GET responses. Deprecated in favor of `ci_partitions_in_seconds_limit_human_readable` and is scheduled for removal in API v5.

ci_partitions_in_seconds_limit_human_rea.description: The time window before new CI partitions are created and the system switches to the next set of partitions. Must be between `1 month` and `6 months`. Defaults to `1 month`.

container_expiration_policies_enable_his.description: Enable cleanup policies for all projects.

container_registry_cleanup_tags_service_.description: The maximum number of tags that can be deleted in a single execution of cleanup policies.

container_registry_delete_tags_service_t.description: The maximum time, in seconds, that the cleanup process can take to delete a batch of tags for cleanup policies.

container_registry_expiration_policies_c.description: Caching during the execution of cleanup policies.

container_registry_expiration_policies_w.description: Number of workers for cleanup policies.

custom_http_clone_url_root.description: Set a custom Git clone URL for HTTP(S).

default_branch_name.description: Set the initial branch name for all projects in an instance.

default_dark_syntax_highlighting_theme.description: Default dark mode syntax highlighting theme for users who are new or not signed in. See [IDs of available themes](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/blob/master/lib/gitlab/themes.rb#L16).

default_preferred_language.description: Default preferred language for users who are not logged in.

default_syntax_highlighting_theme.description: Default syntax highlighting theme for users who are new or not signed in. See [IDs of available themes](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/blob/master/lib/gitlab/themes.rb#L16).

delete_inactive_projects.description: Enable dormant project deletion. Default is `false`.

deletion_adjourned_period.description: Number of days to wait before deleting a project or group that is marked for deletion. Value must be between `1` and `90`. Defaults to `30`.

diff_max_commits.description: Maximum number of diff commits per merge request.

diff_max_patch_bytes.description: Maximum diff patch size, in bytes.

diff_max_versions.description: Maximum number of diff versions per merge request.

disable_password_authentication_for_user.description: Disable password authentication in the web interface for users with an SSO identity. This does not affect Git operations over HTTP(S). Default is `false`.

email_restrictions.description: Regular expression that is checked against the email used during registration.

email_restrictions_enabled.description: Prevent new users from creating an account by email.

enforce_terms.description: (**If enabled, requires**: `terms`) Enforce application ToS to all users.

external_auth_client_cert.description: (**If enabled, requires**: `external_auth_client_key`) The certificate to use to authenticate with the external authorization service.

external_auth_client_key.description: Private key for the certificate when authentication is required for the external authorization service, this is encrypted when stored.

external_auth_client_key_pass.description: Passphrase to use for the private key when authenticating with the external service this is encrypted when stored.

external_authorization_service_default_l.description: The default classification label to use when requesting authorization and no classification label has been specified on the project.

external_authorization_service_enabled.description: (**If enabled, requires**: `external_authorization_service_default_label`, `external_authorization_service_timeout`, and `external_authorization_service_url`) Enable using an external authorization service for accessing projects.

external_authorization_service_timeout.description: The timeout after which an authorization request is aborted, in seconds. When a request times out, access is denied to the user. (min: 0.001, max: 10, step: 0.001).

external_authorization_service_url.description: URL to which authorization requests are directed.

external_pipeline_validation_service_tim.description: How long to wait for a response from the pipeline validation service. Assumes `OK` if it times out.

external_pipeline_validation_service_tok.description: Optional. Token to include as the `X-Gitlab-Token` header in requests to the URL in `external_pipeline_validation_service_url`.

external_pipeline_validation_service_url.description: URL to use for pipeline validation requests.

failed_login_attempts_unlock_period_in_m.description: Time period in minutes after which the user is unlocked when maximum number of failed sign-in attempts reached.

first_day_of_week.description: Start day of the week for calendar views and date pickers. Valid values are `0` (default) for Sunday, `1` for Monday, and `6` for Saturday.

gitlab_dedicated_instance.description: Indicates whether the instance was provisioned for GitLab Dedicated.

gitlab_environment_toolkit_instance.description: Indicates whether the instance was provisioned with the GitLab Environment Toolkit for Service Ping reporting.

gitlab_product_usage_data_enabled.description: Indicates if product usage data collection is enabled. When the `GITLAB_PRODUCT_USAGE_DATA_ENABLED` environment variable is set, the API returns the effective value from the environment variable.

gitlab_shell_operation_limit.description: Maximum number of Git operations per minute a user can perform. Default: `600`.

hashed_storage_enabled.description: Create new projects using hashed storage paths: Enable immutable, hash-based paths and repository names to store repositories on disk. This prevents repositories from having to be moved or renamed when the Project URL changes and may improve disk I/O performance. (Always enabled in GitLab versions 13.0 and later, configuration is scheduled for removal in 14.0)

hide_third_party_offers.description: Do not display offers from third parties in GitLab.

inactive_projects_delete_after_months.description: If `delete_inactive_projects` is `true`, the time (in months) to wait before deleting dormant projects. Default is `2`.

inactive_projects_min_size_mb.description: If `delete_inactive_projects` is `true`, the minimum repository size for projects to be checked for inactivity. Default is `0`.

inactive_projects_send_warning_email_aft.description: If `delete_inactive_projects` is `true`, sets the time (in months) to wait before emailing Maintainers that the project is scheduled to be deleted because it is dormant. Default is `1`.

inactive_resource_access_tokens_delete_a.description: Specifies retention period for inactive project and group access tokens. Default is `30`.

include_optional_metrics_in_service_ping.description: Whether or not optional metrics are enabled in Service Ping.

keep_latest_artifact.description: Prevent the deletion of the artifacts from the most recent successful jobs, regardless of the expiry time. Enabled by default.

kroki_diagram_proxy_enabled.description: Enable Kroki diagram proxy. Default is `false`.

kroki_formats.description: Additional formats supported by the Kroki instance. Possible values are `true` or `false` for formats `bpmn`, `blockdiag`, `excalidraw`, and `mermaid` in the format `<format>: true` or `<format>: false`.

lock_require_sha_for_merge.description: Enforce the `require_sha_for_merge` setting for all groups on the instance. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/236732) in GitLab 19.2.

max_http_decompressed_size.description: Maximum allowed size in MiB for Gzip-compressed HTTP responses from outbound requests after decompression. 0 for unlimited.

max_http_response_csv_structural_chars.description: Maximum allowed object count in CSV HTTP responses from outbound requests. Count is an estimate based on the number of `,`, `;`, `\t`, and `\n` occurrences in the response. Introduced in GitLab 18.4.

max_http_response_json_depth.description: Maximum allowed nesting depth in JSON HTTP responses from outbound requests.

max_http_response_json_structural_chars.description: Maximum allowed object count in JSON HTTP responses from outbound requests. Count is an estimate based on the number of `:`, `,`, `{`, and `[` occurrences in the response. Introduced in GitLab 18.4.

max_http_response_size_limit.description: Maximum allowed size in MiB for HTTP responses from outbound requests. 0 for unlimited. Applicable for integrations, importers, and webhooks. Introduced in GitLab 18.4.

max_http_response_xml_structural_chars.description: Maximum allowed object count in XML HTTP responses from outbound requests. Count is an estimate based on the number of `<`, and `=` occurrences in the response. Introduced in GitLab 18.4.

max_login_attempts.description: Maximum number of sign-in attempts before locking out the user.

max_yaml_depth.description: The maximum depth of nested CI/CD configuration added with the `include` keyword. Default: `100`.

max_yaml_size_bytes.description: The maximum size in bytes of a single CI/CD configuration file. Default: `2097152`.

minimum_password_length.description: Indicates whether passwords require a minimum length. Premium and Ultimate only.

mirror_available.description: Allow repository mirroring to configured by project Maintainers. If disabled, only Administrators can configure repository mirroring.

notify_on_unknown_sign_in.description: Enable sending notification if sign in from unknown IP address happens.

offline_transfer_exports_enabled.description: Enable exporting GitLab groups and projects by offline transfer. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/588971) in GitLab 19.3.

offline_transfer_imports_enabled.description: Enable importing GitLab groups and projects by offline transfer. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/588971) in GitLab 19.3.

package_registry_allow_anyone_to_pull_op.description: Enable to allow anyone to pull from package registry visible and changeable.

package_registry_cleanup_policies_worker.description: Number of workers assigned to the packages cleanup policies.

pages_domain_verification_enabled.description: Require users to prove ownership of custom domains. Domain verification is an essential security measure for public GitLab sites. Users are required to demonstrate they control a domain before it is enabled.

pages_unique_domain_default_enabled.description: Enable unique domains by default for Pages sites to avoid cookie sharing between sites under a given namespace. Default is `true`.

plantuml_diagram_proxy_enabled.description: Enable PlantUML diagram proxy. Default is `false`.

projects_api_rate_limit_unauthenticated.description: Maximum number of requests per 10 minutes per IP address for unauthenticated requests to the list all projects API. Default: 400. To disable throttling, set to 0.

protected_ci_variables.description: CI/CD variables are protected by default.

rate_limiting_response_text.description: When rate limiting is enabled via the `throttle_*` settings, send this plain text response when a rate limit is exceeded. 'Retry later' is sent if this is blank.

relation_export_batch_size.description: The size of each batch when exporting batched relations. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/194607) in GitLab 18.2.

require_admin_two_factor_authentication.description: Allow administrators to require 2FA for all administrators on the instance.

require_email_verification_on_account_lo.description: If `true`, all users on the instance must verify their identity after suspicious sign-in activity is detected.

require_sha_for_merge.description: Instance default that requires a valid commit `sha` for calls to the merge a merge request endpoint. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/236732) in GitLab 19.2.

runner_jobs_endpoints_api_limit.description: Maximum number of requests per minute per job token for requests to `/jobs/*` requests to the runner jobs API endpoints. Default: 200. To disable throttling, set to 0. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/462537) in GitLab 18.5.

runner_jobs_patch_trace_api_limit.description: Maximum number of requests per minute per runner token for requests to the `PATCH /jobs/:id/trace` runner jobs API endpoint. Default: 2000. To disable throttling, set to 0. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/462537) in GitLab 18.5.

runner_jobs_request_api_limit.description: Maximum number of requests per minute per runner token for requests to the `/jobs/request` runner jobs API endpoint. Default: 2000. To disable throttling, set to 0. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/462537) in GitLab 18.5.

search_rate_limit.description: Maximum number of requests per minute for performing a search while authenticated. Default: 30. To disable throttling, set to 0.

search_rate_limit_unauthenticated.description: Maximum number of requests per minute for performing a search while unauthenticated. Default: 10. To disable throttling, set to 0.

sidekiq_job_limiter_compression_threshol.description: The threshold in bytes at which Sidekiq jobs are compressed before being stored in Redis. Default: 100,000 bytes (100 KB).

sidekiq_job_limiter_limit_bytes.description: The threshold in bytes at which Sidekiq jobs are rejected. Default: 0 bytes (doesn't reject any job).

sidekiq_job_limiter_mode.description: `track` or `compress`. Sets the behavior for Sidekiq job size limits. Default: 'compress'.

sidekiq_timezone_override.description: IANA timezone identifier (for example, `America/Chicago`) applied to all Sidekiq cron jobs. When blank, no override is applied and cron jobs use the Rails application timezone.

silent_admin_exports_enabled.description: Enable Silent admin exports. Default is `false`.

snippet_size_limit.description: Maximum snippet content size in **bytes**. Default: 52428800 Bytes (50 MB).

snowplow_database_collector_hostname.description: The Snowplow collector for database events hostname. (for example, `db-snowplow.trx.gitlab.net`)

spam_check_api_key.description: API key used by GitLab for accessing the Spam Check service endpoint.

static_objects_external_storage_auth_tok.description: Authentication token for the external storage linked in `static_objects_external_storage_url`.

static_objects_external_storage_url.description: URL to an external storage for repository static objects.

terms.description: (**Required by**: `enforce_terms`) Markdown content for the ToS.

throttle_authenticated_api_enabled.description: (**If enabled, requires**: `throttle_authenticated_api_period_in_seconds` and `throttle_authenticated_api_requests_per_period`) Enable authenticated API request rate limit. Helps reduce request volume (for example, from crawlers or abusive bots).

throttle_authenticated_api_requests_per_.description: Maximum requests per period per user.

throttle_authenticated_git_http_enabled.description: If `true`, enforces the authenticated Git HTTP request rate limit. Default value: `false`.

throttle_authenticated_git_http_period_i.description: Rate limit period in seconds. `throttle_authenticated_git_http_enabled` must be `true`. Default value: `3600`.

throttle_authenticated_git_http_requests.description: Maximum requests per period per user. `throttle_authenticated_git_http_enabled` must be `true`. Default value: `3600`.

throttle_authenticated_packages_api_enab.description: (**If enabled, requires**: `throttle_authenticated_packages_api_period_in_seconds` and `throttle_authenticated_packages_api_requests_per_period`) Enable authenticated API request rate limit. Helps reduce request volume (for example, from crawlers or abusive bots).

throttle_authenticated_packages_api_requ.description: Maximum requests per period per user.

throttle_authenticated_web_enabled.description: (**If enabled, requires**: `throttle_authenticated_web_period_in_seconds` and `throttle_authenticated_web_requests_per_period`) Enable authenticated web request rate limit. Helps reduce request volume (for example, from crawlers or abusive bots).

throttle_authenticated_web_requests_per_.description: Maximum requests per period per user.

throttle_unauthenticated_api_enabled.description: (**If enabled, requires**: `throttle_unauthenticated_api_period_in_seconds` and `throttle_unauthenticated_api_requests_per_period`) Enable unauthenticated API request rate limit. Helps reduce request volume (for example, from crawlers or abusive bots).

throttle_unauthenticated_api_requests_pe.description: Maximum requests per period per IP.

throttle_unauthenticated_enabled.description: ([Deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/335300) in GitLab 14.3. Use `throttle_unauthenticated_web_enabled` or `throttle_unauthenticated_api_enabled` instead.) (**If enabled, requires**: `throttle_unauthenticated_period_in_seconds` and `throttle_unauthenticated_requests_per_period`) Enable unauthenticated web request rate limit. Helps reduce request volume (for example, from crawlers or abusive bots).

throttle_unauthenticated_git_http_enable.description: If `true`, enforces the unauthenticated Git HTTP request rate limit. Default value: `false`.

throttle_unauthenticated_git_http_period.description: Rate limit period in seconds. `throttle_unauthenticated_git_http_enabled` must be `true`. Default value: `3600`.

throttle_unauthenticated_git_http_reques.description: Maximum requests per period per IP. `throttle_unauthenticated_git_http_enabled` must be `true`. Default value: `3600`.

throttle_unauthenticated_packages_api_en.description: (**If enabled, requires**: `throttle_unauthenticated_packages_api_period_in_seconds` and `throttle_unauthenticated_packages_api_requests_per_period`) Enable unauthenticated API request rate limit. Helps reduce request volume (for example, from crawlers or abusive bots).

throttle_unauthenticated_packages_api_re.description: Maximum requests per period per user.

throttle_unauthenticated_period_in_secon.description: ([Deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/335300) in GitLab 14.3. Use `throttle_unauthenticated_web_period_in_seconds` or `throttle_unauthenticated_api_period_in_seconds` instead.) Rate limit period in seconds.

throttle_unauthenticated_requests_per_pe.description: ([Deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/335300) in GitLab 14.3. Use `throttle_unauthenticated_web_requests_per_period` or `throttle_unauthenticated_api_requests_per_period` instead.) Maximum requests per period per IP.

throttle_unauthenticated_web_enabled.description: (**If enabled, requires**: `throttle_unauthenticated_web_period_in_seconds` and `throttle_unauthenticated_web_requests_per_period`) Enable unauthenticated web request rate limit. Helps reduce request volume (for example, from crawlers or abusive bots).

throttle_unauthenticated_web_requests_pe.description: Maximum requests per period per IP.

time_tracking_limit_to_hours.description: Limit display of time tracking units to hours. Default is `false`.

top_level_group_creation_enabled.description: Allows a user to create top-level-groups. Default is `true`.

unique_ips_limit_enabled.description: (**If enabled, requires**: `unique_ips_limit_per_user` and `unique_ips_limit_time_window`) Limit sign in from multiple IPs.

unique_ips_limit_per_user.description: Maximum number of IPs per user.

unique_ips_limit_time_window.description: How many seconds an IP is counted towards the limit.

update_runner_versions_enabled.description: Fetch GitLab Runner release version data from GitLab.com.

use_clickhouse_for_analytics.description: Enables ClickHouse as a data source for analytics reports. ClickHouse must be configured for this setting to take effect. Available on Premium and Ultimate only.

user_default_external.description: Newly registered users are external by default.

user_default_internal_regex.description: Specify an email address regex pattern to identify default internal users.

user_defaults_to_private_profile.description: Newly created users have private profile by default. Defaults to `false`.

user_oauth_applications.description: Allow users to register any application to use GitLab as an OAuth provider. This setting does not affect group-level OAuth applications.

user_show_add_ssh_key_message.description: When set to `false` disable the `You won't be able to pull or push repositories via SSH until you add an SSH key to your profile` warning shown to users with no uploaded SSH key.

users_api_limit_followers.description: Maximum number of requests per minute, per user or IP address. Default: 100. Set to `0` to disable limits. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/181054) in GitLab 17.10.

users_api_limit_following.description: Maximum number of requests per minute, per user or IP address. Default: 100. Set to `0` to disable limits. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/181054) in GitLab 17.10.

users_api_limit_gpg_key.description: Maximum number of requests per minute, per user or IP address. Default: 120. Set to `0` to disable limits. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/181054) in GitLab 17.10.

users_api_limit_gpg_keys.description: Maximum number of requests per minute, per user or IP address. Default: 120. Set to `0` to disable limits. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/181054) in GitLab 17.10.

users_api_limit_status.description: Maximum number of requests per minute, per user or IP address. Default: 240. Set to `0` to disable limits. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/181054) in GitLab 17.10.

version_check_enabled.description: Let GitLab inform you when an update is available.

web_hook_event_resend_limit.description: Maximum number of webhook event resend requests per minute, per user, for a given project or group. Default: 5. Set to `0` to disable limits. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/587887) in GitLab 19.3.

web_hook_test_limit.description: Maximum number of webhook test requests per minute, per user, for a given project or group. Default: 5. Set to `0` to disable limits. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/587887) in GitLab 19.3.

elasticsearch_pause_indexing.description: Pause Elasticsearch indexing (global control for both Advanced Search and ActiveContext)

elasticsearch_limit_indexing.description: Limit Elasticsearch to index certain namespaces and projects

elasticsearch_project_ids.description: The project ids to index with Elasticsearch.

secret_detection_revocation_token_types_.description: The configured Secret Detection Revocation Token Types instance URL

email_additional_text.description: Additional text added to the bottom of every email for legal/auditing/compliance reasons

default_project_deletion_protection.description: Disable project owners ability to delete project

file_template_project_id.description: ID of project where instance-level file templates are stored.

updating_name_disabled_for_users.description: Flag indicating if users are permitted to update their profile name

disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_r.description: Disable Users ability to overwrite approvers in merge requests.

prevent_merge_requests_author_approval.description: Disable Merge request author ability to approve request.

prevent_merge_requests_committers_approv.description: Disable Merge request committer ability to approve request.

maven_package_requests_forwarding.description: Maven package requests are forwarded to repo.maven.apache.org if not found on GitLab.

npm_package_requests_forwarding.description: NPM package requests are forwarded to npmjs.org if not found on GitLab.

pypi_package_requests_forwarding.description: PyPI package requests are forwarded to pypi.org if not found on GitLab.

rubygems_package_requests_forwarding.description: RubyGems package requests are forwarded to rubygems.org if not found on GitLab.

virtual_registries_endpoints_api_limit.description: Virtual Registries API endpoints rate limit.

group_owners_can_manage_default_branch_p.description: Allow owners to manage default branch protection in groups

maintenance_mode.description: When instance is in maintenance mode, non-admin users can sign in with read-only access and make read-only API requests

maintenance_mode_message.description: Message displayed when instance is in maintenance mode

git_two_factor_session_expiry.description: Maximum duration (in minutes) of a session for Git operations when 2FA is enabled

max_number_of_repository_downloads.description: Maximum number of unique repositories a user can download in the specified time period before they are banned

git_rate_limit_users_allowlist.description: List of usernames excluded from Git anti-abuse rate limits

git_rate_limit_users_alertlist.description: List of user ids who will be emailed when Git abuse rate limit is exceeded

auto_ban_user_on_excessive_projects_down.description: Ban users from the application when they exceed maximum number of unique projects download in the specified time period

make_profile_private.description: Flag indicating if users are permitted to make their profiles private

service_access_tokens_expiration_enforce.description: To enforce token expiration for Service accounts users

duo_features_enabled.description: Indicates whether GitLab Duo features are enabled for the group

lock_duo_features_enabled.description: Indicates if the GitLab Duo features enabled setting is enforced for all subgroups

disabled_direct_code_suggestions.description: Indicates if direct connection for Code Suggestions is disabled for users

receptive_cluster_agents_enabled.description: Enable receptive mode for GitLab Agents for Kubernetes

auto_duo_code_review_enabled.description: Enable automatic reviews by GitLab Duo on merge requests

security_scan_stale_after_days.description: Number of days before security scan data is considered stale (7-90)

duo_custom_agents_enabled.description: Indicates whether custom agents are allowed for this instance

lock_duo_custom_agents_enabled.description: Indicates if the custom agents enabled setting is enforced for all groups

duo_custom_flows_enabled.description: Indicates whether custom flows are allowed for this instance

lock_duo_custom_flows_enabled.description: Indicates if the custom flows enabled setting is enforced for all groups

duo_external_agents_enabled.description: Indicates whether external agents are allowed for this instance

lock_duo_external_agents_enabled.description: Indicates if the external agents enabled setting is enforced for all groups

duo_remote_flows_enabled.description: Indicates whether GitLab Duo remote flows are enabled for the instance

lock_duo_remote_flows_enabled.description: Indicates if the GitLab Duo remote flows enabled setting is enforced for all subgroups

duo_workflows_default_image_registry.description: Default container registry for Duo Agent Platform foundational flow images

ci_telemetry_otel_endpoint.description: OTEL Collector endpoint URL for CI job telemetry

ci_job_telemetry_sampling_rate.description: Sampling rate for CI job telemetry (0.0 to 1.0)

duo_namespace_access_rules.description: AI entity access rules for controlling Duo feature access

full_path.description: Full path of the through namespace

built_in_project_templates_enabled.description: Enable built-in project templates for project creation

lock_built_in_project_templates_enabled.description: Enforce the built-in project templates setting for all groups

duo_template_project_id.description: The ID of a project to use as the Duo Code Review custom instructions template for this instance

use_nats_for_audit_streaming.description: Route audit event streaming through NATS JetStream when the instance has NATS configured

allow_all_integrations.description: When `false`, only integrations in `allowed_integrations` are allowed on the instance. Ultimate only.

allow_group_owners_to_manage_ldap.description: Set to `true` to allow group owners to manage LDAP. Premium and Ultimate only.

allowed_integrations.description: When `allow_all_integrations` is `false`, only integrations in this list are allowed on the instance. Ultimate only.

automatic_purchased_storage_allocation.description: Enabling this permits automatic allocation of purchased storage in a namespace. Relevant only to EE distributions.

check_namespace_plan.description: Enabling this makes only licensed EE features available to projects if the project namespace's plan includes the feature or if the project is public. Premium and Ultimate only.

delete_unconfirmed_users.description: Specifies whether users who have not confirmed their email should be deleted. Default is `false`. When set to `true`, unconfirmed users are deleted after `unconfirmed_users_delete_after_days` days. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.

disable_invite_members.description: Disable invite members functionality for group.

elasticsearch_client_adapter.description: The Faraday adapter used by the Elasticsearch Ruby Client. Defaults to `typhoeus`. Possible values are `typhoeus` and `net_http`. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/550805) in GitLab 18.5. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_indexed_field_length_limit.description: Maximum size of text fields to index by Elasticsearch. 0 value means no limit. This does not apply to repository and wiki indexing. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_indexed_file_size_limit_kb.description: Maximum size of repository and wiki files that are indexed by Elasticsearch. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_max_bulk_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrency of Elasticsearch bulk requests per indexing operation. This only applies to repository indexing operations. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_max_bulk_size_mb.description: Maximum size of Elasticsearch bulk indexing requests in MB. This only applies to repository indexing operations. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_max_code_indexing_concurre.description: Maximum concurrency of Elasticsearch code indexing background jobs. This only applies to repository indexing operations. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_replicas.description:
Number of replicas for Elasticsearch indices. Use an integer to set all indices to the same value. Use an object to set per-index values. For example: `{"gitlab-production": 1, "gitlab-production-notes": 2}`.
When using an object, you must provide both `elasticsearch_shards` and `elasticsearch_replicas` for each index. If either value is missing for an index, that index is skipped. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_requeue_workers.description: Enable automatic requeuing of indexing workers. This improves non-code indexing throughput by enqueuing Sidekiq jobs until all documents are processed. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_retry_on_failure.description: Maximum number of possible retries for Elasticsearch search requests. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_shards.description:
Number of shards for Elasticsearch indices. Use an integer to set all indices to the same value. Use an object to set per-index values. For example: `{"gitlab-production": 5, "gitlab-production-notes": 3}`.
When using an object, you must provide both `elasticsearch_shards` and `elasticsearch_replicas` for each index. If either value is missing for an index, that index is skipped. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_worker_number_of_shards.description: Number of indexing worker shards. This improves non-code indexing throughput by enqueuing more parallel Sidekiq jobs. Default is `2`. Premium and Ultimate only.

enforce_namespace_storage_limit.description: Enabling this permits enforcement of namespace storage limits.

enforce_pipl_compliance.description: Sets whether pipl compliance is enforced for the saas application or not

geo_node_allowed_ips.description: Comma-separated list of IPs and CIDRs of allowed secondary nodes. For example, `1.1.1.1, 2.2.2.0/24`. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.

geo_status_timeout.description: The amount of seconds after which a request to get a secondary node status times out. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.

globally_allowed_ips.description: Comma-separated list of IP addresses and CIDRs always allowed for inbound traffic. For example, `1.1.1.1, 2.2.2.0/24`.

group_secrets_limit.description: Maximum number of secrets allowed per group in Secrets Manager. Default: 500. To disable the limit, set to `0`. Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/219436) in GitLab 18.9.

lock_memberships_to_saml.description: Enforce a global lock on SAML group memberships.

max_personal_access_token_lifetime.description: Maximum allowable lifetime for access tokens in days. When left blank, default value of 365 is applied. When set, value must be 365 or less. When changed, existing access tokens with an expiration date beyond the maximum allowable lifetime are revoked. GitLab Self-Managed, Ultimate only. In GitLab 17.6 or later, the maximum lifetime limit can be [extended to 400 days](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/461901) by enabling a feature flag named `buffered_token_expiration_limit`.

max_ssh_key_lifetime.description: Maximum allowable lifetime for SSH keys in days. GitLab Self-Managed, Ultimate only. In GitLab 17.6 or later, the maximum lifetime limit can be [extended to 400 days](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/461901) by enabling a feature flag named `buffered_token_expiration_limit`.

mirror_capacity_threshold.description: Minimum capacity to be available before scheduling more mirrors preemptively. Premium and Ultimate only.

mirror_max_capacity.description: Maximum number of mirrors that can be synchronizing at the same time. Premium and Ultimate only.

mirror_max_delay.description: Maximum time (in minutes) between updates that a mirror can have when scheduled to synchronize. Premium and Ultimate only.

package_metadata_purl_types.description: List of package registry metadata to sync. See [the list](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/blob/ace16c20d5da7c4928dd03fb139692638b557fe3/app/models/concerns/enums/package_metadata.rb#L5) of the available values. GitLab Self-Managed, Ultimate only.

password_lowercase_required.description: Indicates whether passwords require at least one lowercase letter. Premium and Ultimate only.

password_number_required.description: Indicates whether passwords require at least one number. Premium and Ultimate only.

password_symbol_required.description: Indicates whether passwords require at least one symbol character. Premium and Ultimate only.

password_uppercase_required.description: Indicates whether passwords require at least one uppercase letter. Premium and Ultimate only.

project_secrets_limit.description: Maximum number of secrets allowed per project in Secrets Manager. Default: 100. To disable the limit, set to `0`. Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/219436) in GitLab 18.9.

scan_execution_policies_action_limit.description: Maximum number of `actions` per scan execution policy. Default: 0. Maximum: 20

scan_execution_policies_schedule_limit.description: Maximum number of `type: schedule` rules per scan execution policy. Default: 0. Maximum: 20

secret_push_protection_available.description: Allow projects to enable secret push protection. This does not enable secret push protection. Ultimate only.

security_approval_policies_limit.description: Maximum number of active merge request approval policies per security policy project. Default: 5. Maximum: 20

security_mr_report_cache_lifetime_minute.description: Number of minutes to cache security reports on merge requests (10-60). Default: 10. Premium and Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/223399) in GitLab 18.10.

shared_runners_minutes.description: Set the maximum number of compute minutes that a group can use on instance runners per month. Premium and Ultimate only.

unconfirmed_users_delete_after_days.description: Specifies how many days after account creation to delete users who have not confirmed their email. Only applicable if `delete_unconfirmed_users` is set to `true`. Must be `1` or greater. Default is `7`. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.
